data.body: Merged: Gerrit 3410 landed on main as 57d45053272 (patch set 0f980b65fa0, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). Two deviations from the plan text, stated for the verifier: (1) the equivalence test checks every rewritten commit against an independent rewrite oracle (same metadata, same parent count, every non-SNAPSHOT blob unchanged, every SNAPSHOT ledger commit_sha mapped to the rewrite of the commit that added the event) instead of embedding the per-commit writer as a test helper; I ran that same test against the previous per-commit engine (module loaded from the pre-change source) and it passes there too, so it fixes behaviour identical to the old writer. (2) The text-format CLI output never printed ledger_entries_rewritten, so only the CollapseResult docstring changed; the JSON output carries the field unchanged in name. No existing test assertion needed changing.
